record.paper_title: Several Open Problems on Banach Spaces (Castro Urdiales 2014)
record.original_question: For p != 2, is the set of all separable Banach spaces that are isomorphic to ell_p a Borel subset of the standard Borel space SB of separable Banach spaces?

artifact.category_tag: Borel complexity of Banach space classes
artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $X$ be a fixed isometrically universal separable Banach space (e.g., $C([0,1])$), and let $\mathrm{SB}$ denote the set of all closed linear subspaces of $X$, equipped with the Effros–Borel structure: the $\sigma$-algebra generated by the sets $\{F \in \mathrm{SB} : F \cap U \neq \emptyset\}$ for $U \subseteq X$ open. Then $\mathrm{SB}$ is a standard Borel space, and every separable Banach space is linearly isometric to some element of $\mathrm{SB}$. For a real number $p$ with $1 \le p < \infty$, $p \neq 2$, let $\mathrm{Iso}(\ell_p) = \{F \in \mathrm{SB} : F \text{ is linearly isomorphic (not necessarily isometric) to } \ell_p\}$. Determine whether $\mathrm{Iso}(\ell_p)$ is a Borel subset of $\mathrm{SB}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Search results indicate that G. Godefroy proved (Houston J. Math., 2017) that the isomorphism classes of $\ell_p$ ($1 \le p < \infty$) are Borel subsets of $\mathrm{SB}$, resolving the question affirmatively. This is referenced in subsequent work by Kurka and others on descriptive complexity of isomorphism classes of Banach spaces.

status_evidence.title: Descriptive complexity of some isomorphism classes of Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Improving results of Godefroy and Saint-Raymond; isomorphism classes of l_p shown to be Borel by Godefroy.
status_evidence.claim: The isomorphism class of ℓ_p is a Borel subset of SB.

status_evidence.title: The isomorphism class of c_0 is not Borel
status_evidence.snippet: References Godefroy's result that isomorphism classes of ℓ_p are Borel, contrasting with c_0.
